name: Leaders in Training (LIT), YMCA Camp Loma Mar
city: Loma Mar, CA (YMCA Camp Loma Mar, 9900 Pescadero Creek Road)
what_you_do: You spend two weeks at an overnight camp in the redwoods learning to lead. You plan and run activities for younger campers, shadow camp staff, and learn how an overnight camp works.
grades: Rising 10th or 11th grade (10th or 11th grade in fall 2027)
who_can_apply: Teens entering 10th or 11th grade. Full acceptance depends on references and an interview. No city or residency rule is stated.
pay_detail: The full LIT program cost is not stated. The application asks for a $25 refundable deposit. Campership (financial aid) applications are part of camp registration, and YMCA of the East Bay members get a camp discount.
duration: Two weeks: July 11 to 16 and July 18 to 23, 2027.
deadline_text: The 2027 LIT application opens January 1, 2027. Interviews are scheduled in spring 2027. The session runs July 11 to 23, 2027. No closing date is posted.
how_to_apply: Starting January 1, 2027, send in the LIT form on the camp's sign up site. Pay a $25 deposit, which you can get back. To get in, you need good references and an interview.
notes: Camp Loma Mar is run by the YMCA of the East Bay, not the San Francisco Y. The only LIT price posted is the $25 deposit. So ask the camp about the full fee and aid before you apply. A regular one week camp session in 2027 costs $1,065. Rising 12th graders can apply to be a Camp Assistant instead. The camp also plans a teen weekend for future camp leaders this winter or spring. Dates are not posted yet. Contact: clmteam@ymcaeastbay.org.
